title: Last Man Tournament
description: Run timed PvP tournaments with sudden death sky arenas, live scoreboards, and admin-only control
body: Last Man Tournament is a Minecraft plugin that lets server admins run cinematic PvP tournaments with timed survival rounds and sudden death finales. Players compete to be the last one standing as a live scoreboard tracks time and remaining contenders. When the timer runs out or an admin triggers it manually, all surviving players are teleported to a massive stone platform high in the sky—generated dynamically in a random dry location. There, the final battle begins. Commands are restricted to admins for full control, and the plugin automatically cleans up scoreboards and resets between matches. Perfect for servers that want fast, mythic PvP events with minimal setup and maximum drama.
